analyzed_vuln.description: Root cause is an off-by-one/invalid index propagation when populating type/attribute bitmaps: cil_typeattribute_to_bitmap iterates bits from cil_attr->types and uses db->val_to_type[i] directly, then writes using sepol_type->s.value - 1 into pdb->type_attr_map/attr_type_map without validating that i maps to a valid type entry and that resulting values are in [1, p_types.nprim]. Malformed CIL can produce inconsistent type/value mappings (including 0/invalid), corrupting ebitmap node metadata for attr_type_map entries. Later ebitmap_match_any in assertion checking dereferences a malformed ebitmap node pointer and performs an out-of-bounds read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input must build a policy with malformed/inconsistent typeattribute/typeattributeset state (via nested blocks/inherits etc.) so that during cil_binary_create_allocated_pdb, cil_typeattribute_to_bitmap processes an invalid bit index from cil_attr->types (or invalid db->val_to_type mapping) and updates attr/type maps with unchecked value-1 indices. Then neverallow checking (check_assertion -> avtab_map -> check_assertion_avtab_match) calls ebitmap_match_any on the corrupted p->attr_type_map[k->source_type-1], triggering the heap-buffer-overflow read.
